Since 1998, the tournament has been held every 2 years. This edition had 16 teams competing in 44 matches between 15 and 30 January 2010. These included the 10 [[List of International Cricket Council members#Full Members|ICC Full Members]] and 6 [[2009 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup Qualifier#Final table|Qualifiers]].{{cite
